body: SurfaceDetail read-only review found a direct D14a/V-L1 conflict: at ReaderAt(token.end) a token is fully visible while its sentence is not, so the proposed per-unit full-span rule yields OnMark at Tokens with no coarser visible ancestor. It also assumes token->sentence topology that SurfaceAtlas.validated does not require. Full reasoning is on the implementer's checkpoint thread. Please rule hierarchical visibility vs scoped V-L1 and the lawful-atlas precondition; no edits from me.
